RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias. Both candidates possess strong, relevant qualifications; the successful applicant’s international project leadership may have simply aligned better with the ministry's specific priorities. 

Civil service recruitment typically relies on standardized competency frameworks and structured scoring, which limits subjective bias. Furthermore, a two-week turnaround for formal written feedback is standard administrative delay in the public sector.

Raising an allegation of sex discrimination without documented procedural breaches or tangible evidence is legally unfounded and could severely harm your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your competency scores and constructive feedback to identify how to strengthen future applications.
